channel.description: This is a randomly ordered feed of the most recent entries from summarizedStoriesMainNLhealthAndWellness, skipping any feeds with errors.

item.title: AI chatbot lowers depression, anxiety, and eating disorder risk symptoms
item.description: Heinz and colleagues assessed a generative AI chatbot for adults with clinically significant depression, anxiety, or elevated eating disorder risk.

item.title: Real-time AI guidance used in live brain tumor surgery
item.description: University College London and UCLH performed the first surgery in an ongoing clinical trial using real-time AI guidance.

item.title: Chronic particulate matter exposure linked to higher cardiovascular risk
item.description: Long-term exposure to particulate matter with diameter ≤2.5 μm (PM2.5) was significantly associated with elevated cardiovascular risk.

item.title: Toxic leadership in medicine penalizes doctors who speak up
item.description: In four consecutive positions, I encountered the same pattern: toxic bosses and non-clinical administrators dictating how physicians should practice.
